evidence.quote: Should inflation pressures remain contained, I would support lowering the policy rate as soon as our next meeting in order to bring it closer to its neutral setting and to sustain a healthy labor market.
As we think about the path forward, it is time to consider adjusting the policy rate.
the underlying trend in core PCE inflation is moving much closer to our 2 percent target than is currently apparent in the data.
I think that we should put more weight on downside risks to our employment mandate going forward.
While still strong, the labor market appears to be less dynamic, with modest hiring rates, layoffs edging up from low levels, and job gains concentrated in just a few industries.
